attachmentType.description: The method or mechanism used to attach or secure the thermocouple to the measurement point (e.g., clamp, adhesive, probe, screw-in).

thermocoupleType.description: The classification of the thermocouple based on its metal alloy combination, which determines its temperature range and sensitivity (e.g., Type K, Type J, Type T, Type N).

circleDiameter.description: Diameter (mm) of the circular surface used to attach the thermocouple to the measurement point, can be used to give an area.

noiseFloor.description: The minimum measurable signal level above background electrical noise, expressed as a percentage
